scope.title: SQLite Deal Store
scope.summary: Add a SQLite persistence layer for deal candidates and qualified deals so pipeline runs are queryable and comparable across runs.
scope.motivation: Currently deal data is written to flat JSON files per run with no way to query across runs, compare deal pipelines over time, or search historical results. A lightweight SQLite store enables cross-run queries without infrastructure overhead.
deliverables: New module src/ptbot/db.py — schema creation, insert/query functions using stdlib sqlite3

Schema: runs table (run_id, params JSON, timestamp), deals table (deal_id, run_id FK, target, acquirer, date, deal_value, multiples_disclosed, computed_multiples_available, multiples JSON, source_urls JSON, qualified bool)
Integration point in orchestrator.run_pipeline — persist candidates and qualified deals after each pass
CLI flag --db-path (default: ~/.ptbot/ptbot.db) to control database location
New test file tests/test_db.py with >=85% coverage on db.py
Passes task check (format, lint, type-check, tests, coverage, build)
constraints: Use only Python stdlib sqlite3 — no new dependencies
Database is optional; pipeline must still work without --db-path
Existing tests must continue to pass unchanged
Frozen pydantic models — do not modify existing model classes
